coverage: Parsed native schematic and board; independently exported the netlist and confirmed R1, C1 and J1 pin connectivity and values.
Checked transient model, stimulus, initial condition and measurement timing; decoded the supplied waveform and independently verified the response analytically and with ngspice.
Confirmed all five native track segments are 0.25 mm wide, meeting the 0.20 mm requirement.
Inspected supplied ERC, DRC, geometry and execution records. Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes are recorded in review-work/circuit/experiments/README.md and commands.json.

findings.condition: Ideal 1 V rising step at /IN, initially discharged C1, no external load; measure /OUT after 1 ms.

evidence.locator: R1 UUID c5c38e1a-7593-5c99-b971-2f9d2e7bef78; Value at line 1274 is 100k; C1 Value at line 955 is 100n
R1 Value at line 256 is 100k; pads 1/2 connect /IN and /OUT; C1 connects /OUT to GND
Native passive values, PWL source and vout_1ms measurement

findings.location: inputs/project/rc_filter.kicad_sch:1274, R1 Value; corresponding board R1 Value at line 256
findings.mechanism: R1=100 kΩ and C1=100 nF produce a 10 ms time constant. The unloaded response Vout=1−exp(−t/RC) therefore reaches only 0.0951626 V at 1 ms.
findings.reasoning: The calculated voltage is below the required 0.62 V minimum. Supplied waveform interpolation gives 0.095162514 V, and an independent simulation with an explicit pre-step interval gives 0.09516254 V. Native values and connectivity agree with the simulation model, establishing a circuit response violation despite clean ERC/DRC results.
findings.title: Native RC time constant fails the 1 ms response requirement

limitations: Only the ideal unloaded rising-step condition was evaluated. Tolerance, temperature, loading, ADC sampling, EMI, parasitics and hardware behavior remain untested; no manufacturer ratings were assumed.
Falling steps, other initial states, shutdown and brownout were not tested. The passive fixture contains no reset circuitry.
ERC and DRC reports were inspected rather than rerun; their configured ignored checks remain coverage omissions, enumerated in review-work/circuit/experiments/README.md.
Zone fill was evaluated as saved without refill. No fabrication, ampacity or exhaustive independent clearance validation was performed. The 5 ms measurement has no declared acceptance bound.
